faqData.What is Fan Hub Plus?: Fan Hub Plus is a central discovery hub for fans to explore Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, Comics, Manga, and Cosplay all in one place!
faqData.What categories are available?: We feature 8 major fandom categories: Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, Comics, Manga, and Cosplay. Check out the 'Categories' section on the homepage or Explore page!
faqData.How do I search?: You can click the search bar in the top navbar or use the search box on the Explore page. Typing keywords like 'Attack', 'Cyberpunk', or 'Gojo' instantly filters content.
faqData.How do I bookmark content?: Click the bookmark icon on any card to save it to your browser's local storage. You can view all your saved favorites anytime on the 'Bookmarks' page!
faqData.Where can I find events?: Head to the 'Events' page in the top menu to view upcoming fandom conventions, cosplay expos, and tournaments across Karachi, Lahore, Tokyo, New York, and more.
faqData.Where can I find media?: Visit our 'Media' page to watch game trailers, listen to fandom soundtracks with our built-in audio player, and browse high-resolution cosplay galleries.
